params._marketplace: MonadMind address; can be address(0) and set later via setMarketplace (e.g. deploy Executor first, then Marketplace).

executeBatch(uint256,address[],uint256[].details: Marketplace must send MON via msg.value = sum(amountsInWei). Checks-Effects-Interactions.

params.amountsInWei: MON amount to use per follower (native token).
params.followers: Array of follower addresses (each must have deposited MON in the marketplace).
params.strategyId: Strategy whose followers are being traded for.
params.tokenOut: Output token address (e.g. Uniswap V2 pair or ERC20).

executeBatch(uint256,address[],uint256[].notice: Execute swaps for multiple followers in one transaction (batch).

setMarketplace(address).notice: Set the MonadMind marketplace (e.g. after deployment). Owner only.

setRouter(address).notice: Set Uniswap V2 router. Zero address = mock-only mode.
